causebase_summary: Young Voices Of Melbourne Inc (YVM) is a Melbourne-based choral organisation described on its website and in ACNC filings. Website posts from 2025–2026 document regular ensemble activity: named ensembles include a Senior Training Choir and a Performing Choir; the organisation ran a ‘‘Supercamp’’ rehearsal weekend from 27 February to 1 March 2026 at CYC Forest Edge for singers from both choirs. The site also records a change in artistic leadership (a new Artistic Director appointed in 2025) and the engagement of an internationally described conductor, Dr Michael Barrett, as an Associate Artist in April 2026. The ACNC AIS extract for 01/02/2023–31/01/2024 reports revenue of AUD 583,709 and total expenses of AUD 658,416 for the reporting subject. The organisation’s legal and public identity is Young Voices Of Melbourne Inc, with a website at yvm.com.au and structured geography listed as Victoria. Public materials on the website focus on rehearsals, weekend training events and artistic appointments; they do not provide detailed breakdowns of participant ages, the frequency or locations of public performances, or staffing and volunteer arrangements.
